experiment_data.hypothesis: Low-b grid sweep (b=0.1, 0.2, 0.3) on ρ=0.4 data, seed42. Confirms behavior in b<0.5 region — expect minimal reweighting effect and PPL close to uniform. Establishes that b=0.5 is already near the lower useful bound.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/provenance_weight_training && for b in 0.1 0.2 0.3; do echo '=== Training grid b='$b' ===' && WANDB_MODE=disabled python training/pretrain_weighted.py --data_path data/scored_data.jsonl --output_dir output/models/grid_b_low_b${b}_seed42 --weighting_method grid --grid_b_value $b --model_name models/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --num_train_tokens 200000000 --batch_size 4 --gradient_accumulation_steps 4 --max_length 2048 --learning_rate 5e-5 --seed 42 --logging_steps 10 --save_steps 500 --save_total_limit 2 --save_only_model --contamination_ratio 0.4 --bf16 || exit 1; done"
